# Digital Insight AI — Full Context

Digital Insight AI is an Arabic website by Ibrahim Albalawi for discovering and comparing AI tools used in business, marketing, content creation, video production, and app development.

## Purpose

- Explain AI tools in clear Arabic.
- Compare tools using practical criteria.
- Help visitors choose tools by use case.
- Support transparent affiliate marketing experiments.
- Track visitor interest, clicks, subscriptions, and contact requests.

## Editorial rules

- Be direct and transparent.
- Do not claim guaranteed income or results.
- Separate facts, opinions, and estimates.
- Prefer practical usefulness over promotional language.
- Disclose affiliate relationships.
- Update comparisons when products materially change.
